scenario: [LTIM.2.7.3] with [LDTL.4.1]: under `dynamic_ttl`, `retain:` may give a fact any lifetime, so no window is refused. `E` lives 10 s and `no E within 60_s` compiles. A compiler that compares the window with the declared TTL under `dynamic_ttl` refuses the program. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.ltim_2_7_3_within_exceeds_ttl`'s `ldtl_dynamic_ttl_file` arm.
rules_ds:
use default:
    dynamic_ttl: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    id: Int key

schema E scope ttl 10_s:
    ts: Time

rule quiet:
    Trig
    no E within 60_s
->
    log info "quiet"
